create_struct_field: create a polars expression to retrieve one or multiple struct fields by name
test_struct_unnest: test the struct unnest method to expand a struct column into its individual fields
refactor_struct_rename_fields: refactor the struct rename_fields method to rename struct field names in order
summarize_struct_json_encode: summarize the struct json_encode method that converts a struct column to json string values
build_struct_with_fields: build a struct expression that adds or overwrites fields using positional and keyword arguments
